notes: Government data centre in Port Vila near the Meteo Department Building, housing nine racks with a second smaller data centre for redundancy; hosts the Vanuatu Internet Exchange (VIX.VU, 6 networks per PeeringDB) and connects to the submarine cable landing station with direct access to an Equinix data centre in Sydney (per DataCenterDynamics, Aug 2025). PeeringDB facility record 2080 updated 2025-09-26. No public MW capacity.
